vision: The V1 harness is built and validated: routing, context construction, schema validation, 6-dimension eval, cost governance, artifact persistence. The agent investigates commits and produces grounded evidence (D6=0.85). But it fails 3/6 acceptance gates — it can't reliably classify risk (D1=0.40) or identify root causes (D3=0.13) without the ground truth label. This phase focuses on improving investigation quality through systematic prompt engineering and eval iteration, not infrastructure changes.
direction: Two-tier improvement: Tier 1 (iter-1/2) — method changes (prompt, context injection) with loop frozen. Tier 2 (triggered by plateau) — loop architecture becomes variable: multi-turn, bundle expansion, judge split. Eval diagnoses; humans change method or loop based on forensics.

prior_phase.name: v1-build
prior_phase.summary: 11 tasks (scaffold → eval run). All done and committed. Built: GroundTruthGraph, GitContextProvider, CommitContextBuilder, AgentOrchestrator, XGBoostRouter, EvalHarness (6D), ReasoningJudge, CursorSDK provider, timestamped runs. 76 tests. Data leakage found and fixed post-V1 (buggy/fix labels).

gate.description: All six must pass simultaneously. Blocks delivery.

target.description: Quality bar for an acceptable deliverable.

acceptance_thresholds.baseline_rule: soft — emit WARNING if D1_agent < D1_always_predict_clean or D1_router_only

current_baseline.note: First clean run after buggy/fix label leak fix. n=5 is too small for conclusions but establishes direction.

tier_2.scope: Loop architecture: max_turns, bundle expansion, judge model split, deterministic context expansion
tier_2.trigger: Post-iter-1 n=20: ΔD3 < 0.05 AND ΔD1 < 0.10, OR EXP-FORENSICS-TAG shows >40% missing-context-likely

cycle: 1. Hypothesize: which prompt/loop change will move which dimension?
2. Implement: change orchestrator.py prompt or context assembly
3. Smoke test: run n=5 to catch regressions quickly (~4 min, ~$0.02)
4. Validate: run n=20 stratified eval to measure dimension scores (~20 min, ~$0.07)
5. Compare: check against baseline and thresholds, analyze per-commit eval JSONs
6. Decide: if gate-trending, run n=50 for statistical confidence; if flat, activate Tier 2
constraints: Oracle isolation must hold — agent never sees buggy/fix/year labels
76+ tests must pass after every change
D6 ≥ 0.70 is a hard regression guard in every eval run
Each iteration tracked as a breadcrumb with before/after scores

failure_analysis.D1_why_failing: Agent defaults to MEDIUM risk. Without the buggy label, it lacks a strong internal signal to push toward HIGH/CRITICAL. The XGBoost router already scored these commits 0.3-0.7 (gray zone), but the agent doesn't see this probability.
failure_analysis.D2_why_failing: Agent lists files it analyzed (touched files from the diff) rather than files most likely to contain the bug. Jaccard penalizes extra files heavily.
failure_analysis.D3_why_failing: Agent describes code structure changes accurately (D6=0.85 proves this) but cannot deduce the failure mechanism — it says 'this is complex' instead of 'this introduces a null pointer when X is empty'. Needs calibration examples showing the difference.

tasks.name: Research spike: optimal investigation harness design
tasks.scope: Define investigation harness as system architecture: ARCHITECTURE.md (identity, method, eval loop, improvement cycle), docs/harness.md (agent loop, control plane, operational enforcement), terminology alignment, agent-loop design critique. Research in docs/spike-investigation-harness.md. No code changes.

tasks.name: Prompt engineering: A+B hybrid + router prior
tasks.scope: Implement spike §5.2 system prompt (rubric + staged CoT + hedge-ban + 2 few-shots) and §5.3 router_probability injection in orchestrator.py. Add fix-commit residual-risk rubric guard. Smoke n=5 (D6≥0.70 revert gate) + individual commits f897d46/90846b5/b4c933b7. Validate n=20: targets D1≥0.50, D3≥0.18. Check 3 reports for few-shot parroting.

tasks.name: Experiment: classify D3 failure modes
tasks.scope: Tag n=50 (or available n=100 eval JSONs) D3≤0.25 commits into {hedging, generic-structure, missing-context-likely, judge-infra}. Determines whether next iteration is method (prompt) or loop (bundle expansion). Run in parallel with iter-1 — does not block prompt implementation.
tasks.decision_rule: If >40% tagged missing-context-likely, prioritize EXP-BUNDLE-EXPAND in iter-2 track

tasks.name: Experiment: multi-turn A/B (max_turns 1 vs 3)
tasks.scope: n=20 stratified eval with iter-1 prompt: max_turns=1 vs max_turns=3, identical bundle. Measure ΔD1, ΔD3, ΔD2, cost/commit, follow-up trigger rate. Score turn-1-only vs final merged report.
tasks.decision_rule: If ΔD3≥0.05 or ΔD1≥0.10 with ≤60% cost increase, merge multi-turn into iter-2 validation — do not defer to iter-3

tasks.name: Validate at n=50 + Tier-2 experiments if triggered
tasks.scope: Run n=50 stratified eval to confirm iter-1 improvements are statistically stable. All 6 gates must pass for delivery. If EXP-MULTITURN-AB shows lift, include max_turns=3 arm. If EXP-FORENSICS-TAG shows missing-context dominance, run EXP-BUNDLE-EXPAND (test files + blame injection) before n=50. Mandate EXP-JUDGE-SWAP before declaring n=50 gate pass.

tasks.name: Experiment: cross-model judge vs same-model
tasks.scope: Re-score n=20 investigation reports with cross-model judge (different provider/model than Sonnet investigator). Compare mean D3/D5, rank correlation, gate flip rate.
tasks.decision_rule: If mean D3 drops ≥0.03 or ≥3 commits flip gate status, mandate split judge before n=50 acceptance

tasks.name: Experiment: deterministic context expansion
tasks.scope: n=5 smoke on D6≥0.7 D3≤0.25 commits: (a) baseline, (b) +auto test files, (c) +blame snippets, (d) b+c. Orchestrator-only flags on CommitContextBuilder — no LLM tool selection.
tasks.decision_rule: If (b) or (c) lifts D3≥0.25 on ≥2/5 without D6 regression, add to context builder before iter-4

tasks.name: Multi-turn investigation (if not merged from EXP-MULTITURN-AB)
tasks.scope: Enable turn 2–3 for low-confidence commits (confidence <0.6, empty localization, explicit uncertainty). Follow-up: targeted failure-mode question + deeper blame/history. Only if EXP-MULTITURN-AB did not already promote multi-turn to iter-2. Same or stronger model on follow-up turns (not cheaper).

tasks.name: D2 localization + deterministic bundle expansion
tasks.scope: Prompt agent to distinguish defect locus from analysis scope. If EXP-BUNDLE-EXPAND showed lift, integrate test-file and blame injection into CommitContextBuilder. May improve with D3 gains from iter-1/3.

tasks.name: Experiment: Sonnet vs Opus on hard commits
tasks.scope: 10 commits with D3=0 and D6≥0.7. Run Sonnet vs Opus/reasoning model, same prompt. Measure ΔD3 and cost.
tasks.decision_rule: If Opus ΔD3≥0.15 on subset, consider tiered routing for INVESTIGATE zone; if flat, stay Sonnet

risks.risk: Prompt changes improve D1 but regress D6 (agent starts guessing instead of grounding)
risks.mitigation: D6≥0.70 is a hard constraint in every eval. Regression = revert.

risks.risk: Few-shot examples cause parroting — agent copies example language instead of reasoning from actual diff
risks.mitigation: EC-2 in contract: check 3 random eval reports for example language leakage

risks.risk: Router probability injection creates a new form of leakage (agent uses P as proxy for buggy)
risks.mitigation: Router is trained on train split only. P correlates with buggy but is not the label — same as any ML feature. Oracle isolation tests verify no GT fields leak.

risks.risk: n=5 baseline is too noisy — improvements may be sample variance
risks.mitigation: iter-2 validates at n=50. Don't declare victory on n=20.

risks.risk: Same-model judge inflates D3 scores — false progress signal
risks.mitigation: EXP-JUDGE-SWAP mandatory before n=50 gate declaration

risks.risk: Prompt-only iteration hits ceiling on integration defects missing test/caller context
risks.mitigation: EXP-FORENSICS-TAG + Tier-2 pivot triggers activate loop experiments
